description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 16.06.2025 to 22.06.2025
categorisation: This gazette content establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and represents a statutory instrument issued by the Director General of Customs under delegated authority. The notification rescinds previous exchange rates and sets new compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories.
